data.long_meaning: The name Shiloma is derived from the Hebrew word shalom, meaning peace. In the Bible, the name Shilomah is associated with the peaceful valley where the prophet Samuel anointed King Saul as the first king of Israel. The name symbolizes a place of calm and serenity, as well as a source of spiritual growth and guidance. The name Shiloma carries the meaning “Peaceful valley” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Shiloma usually hope their child will grow to embody peaceful valley and live with faith, good character and purpose.
